label: Referrer name, role and organisation
note: Renders in plan consultation - 'who you spoke to'.

label: Health screen - danger or RRP identified
note: Conditional. Shown only when RRP is identified or immediate danger is flagged. Distinct from health.record.

label: Health conditions
note: Sourced from other providers' documents via the source register.

label: Placement and service stability
note: Informs strategy authoring. Does not render in the plan - strategies are based on it, it is not restated.

label: Observable family present
note: yes | no | unanswered. 'unanswered' must survive downstream as a stated assessment gap.

label: What this looks like for this participant
What people currently do in response
Setting events
note: Informs strategy authoring. Does not render in the plan.

label: Competing hypotheses
note: Recorded from Frame's assessment where available.

label: Evidence reconciliation
note: Recorded from Frame's assessment where available.

label: Pattern interpretation
note: Recorded from Frame's assessment where available.

label: Formulation
note: Recorded from Frame's assessment where available.

label: Maintaining variables
note: Recorded from Frame's assessment where available.

label: Behavioural function
note: Recorded from Frame's assessment where available.

label: Practitioner conclusion, confidence and limitations
note: Hard clinical gate. Approval here sets fba.approved.

label: Temporary safeguard rationale (unassessed)
note: Explicitly labelled unassessed. Requires a disposition before a Comprehensive can release.

label: RRP status
note: none | possible_unclear | confirmed. Practitioner-authored. No keyword or checkbox may set this.

label: Practitioner triage outcome
note: accept | request_information | waitlist | decline. Never algorithmic.

label: Likelihood (1-5)
note: Practitioner-scored. Standard 5x5 matrix.

label: Consequence (1-5)
note: Practitioner-scored. Standard 5x5 matrix.

label: Risk rating
note: DERIVED, read-only: likelihood x consequence. Display only. MD-019 - it must not gate, rank or set the pathway. triage.rrp_status and triage.outcome stay practitioner-authored regardless of this number.

label: Is the referrer the participant themselves?
note: Options: yes | no. "no" reveals the relationship and awareness questions below.

label: Referrer's relationship to the participant
note: Shown only when referrer.is_participant is "no".

label: Does the participant know this referral is being made?
note: Options: yes | no | unsure. Shown only when referrer.is_participant is "no".

label: Guardian/nominee contact details
note: Shown only when guardian.name_role has been entered.

label: Is this referral urgent?
note: Options: yes | no. Flags for human priority review only — never determines acceptance or clinical pathway.

label: Briefly explain the urgency
note: Required only when referral.urgent is "yes".

label: NDIS funding status for this support
note: Options: confirmed | unknown | not_applicable. "unknown" never blocks submission — funding uncertainty must never block clinical triage.

label: Type of existing plan
note: Options: no_rp | interim | comprehensive | unknown. Shown only when existing.bsp is "yes".

label: Date of existing plan
note: Shown only when existing.bsp is "yes".

label: Existing plan's practitioner
note: Shown only when existing.bsp is "yes".

label: Request a copy of the existing plan
note: Shown only when existing.bsp is "yes".

label: Which regulated restrictive practice(s) are in use?
note: Practitioner's own selection — drives which of 10.2-10.6 apply. Not inferred.

label: Plan to reduce or eliminate — Seclusion
Since (when this practice started) — Chemical restraint
Plan to reduce or eliminate — Chemical restraint
Duration and review date — Chemical restraint
Since (when this practice started) — Mechanical restraint
Plan to reduce or eliminate — Mechanical restraint
Duration and review date — Mechanical restraint
Since (when this practice started) — Physical restraint
Plan to reduce or eliminate — Physical restraint
Duration and review date — Physical restraint
Since (when this practice started) — Environmental restraint
Plan to reduce or eliminate — Environmental restraint
Duration and review date — Environmental restraint
Frequency — Chemical restraint
note: PRN or Routine.

label: Route of administration — Chemical restraint
note: Oral or Other.

label: Restrictive practices in use, if any
note: Practitioner's own summary. Full per-practice detail is quoted from the RRP Assessment (document 10) via rendersIn, not re-entered here.

label: Impact on the person and their family
Travel time (hours, return)
note: Apportioned per (travel_hours / 2) / participants_seen_this_trip x rate - not a flat loading.

label: Specialist behaviour intervention support (direct sessions) - hours
Incident data collection and review - hours
Restrictive practice status update
note: Also used to flag a restrictive practice newly introduced since the last version, including under a No-RP plan.

label: Practitioner declaration
note: Practitioner's own sign-off on this review's findings and changes.
